en.summary: The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Election Commission and Centre regarding a challenge to decisions made by the Chief Election Commissioner-led panel, with the Chief Justice noting that allegations against the ECI stem from media reports.

stories.title: Trio win Nobel prize for leap in optogenetics; how it unlocks brain's mysteries

en.title: Trio win Nobel prize for leap in optogenetics; how it unlocks brain's mysteries
en.summary: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing optogenetics, a technique using light-gated ion channels to control nerve cell activity in living brains, potentially advancing treatments for visual impairments and neural disorders.

stories.title: Supreme Court refuses to stay Calcutta HC order in Great Nicobar Island Project; terms ‘preservation of culture’ a fundamental right

en.title: Supreme Court refuses to stay Calcutta HC order in Great Nicobar Island Project; terms 'preservation of culture' a fundamental right
en.summary: India's Supreme Court declined to halt a High Court order regarding the Great Nicobar Island Project, recognizing cultural preservation as a fundamental right after petitions raised concerns that forest diversion threatened indigenous Shompen and Nicobarese communities.

en.title: 'Mere paternity dispute not enough': Kerala High Court refuses to order child's DNA test
en.summary: The Kerala High Court declined to order a DNA test for a child in a case involving only a paternity dispute, indicating that such a dispute alone does not justify the test.

stories.title: Noida suicide: Court ordered Rs 15 lakh alimony, Gurgaon techie was due to pay half

en.title: Noida suicide: Court ordered Rs 15 lakh alimony, Gurgaon techie was due to pay half
en.summary: A 28-year-old software engineer in Noida died by suicide amid financial difficulties, including court-ordered alimony payments to his ex-wife and mounting debts. Police are investigating his financial circumstances and communications preceding the incident.

stories.title: Bajaj Finance shares jump 5% after Q2 business update. Why Jefferies sees 35% upside in its top pick?

en.title: Crash alert! V2 Retail shares plunge 20% on Q2 business update; festive season shift weighs on growth
en.summary: V2 Retail shares declined 20% despite revenue rising 28.4% year-on-year to Rs 905 crore, as same-store sales growth remained minimal due to calendar shifts in major festivals affecting quarterly comparisons.

en.summary: Yes Bank's share price increased following Q2 FY27 results showing 23.8% year-on-year loan growth to around Rs 3.1 lakh crore and nearly 20% deposit growth, indicating continued business momentum.

stories.title: HDFC Bank shares rise 2% after appointing Anup Bagchi as new CEO, Q2 biz update. Buy, sell or hold?

en.title: HDFC Bank shares rise 2% after appointing Anup Bagchi as new CEO, Q2 biz update. Buy, sell or hold?
